sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Liath Macha is an Irish legendary animal. The name means the gray of the goddess Macha. It was her favorite horse, the steed of the Ulster hero Cúchulainn. The horse came from a lake by magic and was a gift from Macha, the main goddess of Ulster.

okr.objective: Hold Liath Macha, the magic horse of Macha, in a short entry.
